title: KAITO — Wanting To Give A Push〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, which SEKAI should I take a look at today?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've been over to see how our troupe is doing quite a lot lately, so maybe I should see what idol me is up to...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We went over to take a look at a couple of the SEKAI and got to see some rare sides of you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-You scared me, KAITO!
I didn't know you were here...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. Sorry for bothering you! Len and I were having a race to see who'd get up to the rooftop first!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But more importantly, that reaction! I didn't realize you could shout in such a big voice.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. He must've been pretty startled if he reacted so loudly he surprised himself.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I also thought the way he reacted was really cute!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, after that, we went over to check out a different SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And the KAITO there also did something interesting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why aren't we allowed to use that high fly trick anymore, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Because it's very dangerous to get sent up so high. I've seen a couple of you soar past the clouds.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, do a safe version for me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I suppose it is my responsibility to come up with an alternative since I'm asking you not to do it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He tossed Miku into the air...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't remember that SEKAI's me being particularly strong or anything...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: He must've tried his very best to not disappoint her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Does this mean you two want me to do the same thing?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Miku seemed to have a ton of fun, so we wanna know what it's like!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we'll go one at a time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Rock paper scissors to see who goes first, Len!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (This place and those SEKAI seem so peaceful.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Hehe. But it's always nice to spend a day like this.)
